hits.description:
Deals 87 (0 + 209% Magic Attack) Magic Damage to an enemy.
Can be used up to 3 times in a row without triggering a cooldown.

Attack 3: Converts 20% of damage dealt to Enervated enemies to mana; inflicts Conflagration on Burning enemies. 
All 3 attacks deal +12% additional damage to targets under freezing effects.
